integrity: Reproducible complete finite enumeration; independently reviewed scientific correctness and originality beyond the same-model mathematical review are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact fourteen-vertex incidence-graph classification only. Four named palette colours and single-site recolouring preserving properness and exact two-colour open neighbourhoods; not a statement for arbitrary cubic graphs or other palettes. Historic mathematical priority has not received independent verification.
title: Four-palette two-homogeneous recolouring of the Heawood graph: 504 seven-vertex trees and 2520 isolated states
